tools.name: pypi_wheel_evidence
tools.description: Reports provider-reported filename/tag intersection for PyPI wheels; it does not perform compatibility, security, or digest verification.

tools.name: network_set_evidence
tools.description: Compares two bounded IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR sets. before contains included ranges and after supplies the second set. For subtraction, put ranges to exclude in after and read removed for before minus after. added is after minus before. Reports canonical CIDR ranges, address counts, and witnesses. Address

tools.name: python_import_layout_evidence
tools.description: Compares one exact PyPI artifact with public GitHub Python source and named consumer files pinned by a full commit or a caller-selected tag ref. Tag refs are resolved and rechecked before full-SHA static reads; results retain the original ref and resolved SHA, and unknown or ambiguous cases stay UNK

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "network_set_evidence" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
